comment: The gain trimmer is configured in volts with a display base of 300 from 0.01, so its tooltip reads 0.01V to 3V. Three of the six knobs have a CV jack, each a tenth of the knob's travel per volt. configBypass passes the input to the output. The maker records the model as the USA V3 of 1976 to 1977. The panel prints raucus, gain, sustain, bias, tone, mids, volume, in, sustain, tone, volume and out.
